What Turing sells

  • Frontier AI: Verified specialists produce coding and reasoning data for advanced AI models.
  • Off-The-Shelf Datasets: Ready-made datasets for model training.
  • RL Environments: Training tasks with prompts and scoring tools.
  • Experts: Specialists who contribute to AI data work.
  • Enterprise AI: Custom AI agents and deployment support for business tasks.
